<script>
(function () {
  const attachBreadcrumbs = () => {
    const revealRoot = document.querySelector('.reveal');
    if (!revealRoot) return;

    let footer = revealRoot.querySelector('.footer-default');
    if (!footer) {
      footer = revealRoot.querySelector('.slide-footer');
    }
    if (!footer) {
      footer = document.createElement('div');
      footer.className = 'footer-default slide-footer';
      revealRoot.appendChild(footer);
    }

    let breadcrumb = footer.querySelector('.slide-breadcrumb');
    if (!breadcrumb) {
      breadcrumb = document.createElement('div');
      breadcrumb.className = 'slide-breadcrumb';
      footer.appendChild(breadcrumb);
    }

    const getHeadingText = (section) => {
      if (!section) return '';

      const selectors = [
        ':scope > h1',
        ':scope > h2',
        ':scope > h3',
        ':scope > h4',
        ':scope > h5',
        ':scope > h6',
        ':scope > section > h1',
        ':scope > section > h2',
        ':scope > section > h3',
        ':scope > section > h4',
        ':scope > section > h5',
        ':scope > section > h6'
      ];

      for (const selector of selectors) {
        const heading = section.querySelector(selector);
        if (heading) {
          return heading.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        }
      }

      return '';
    };

    const updateBreadcrumb = () => {
      const present = document.querySelector('.reveal .slides section.present');
      if (!present) return;

      const trail = [];
      let current = present;
      while (current && current.tagName === 'SECTION') {
        const heading = getHeadingText(current);
        if (heading && !trail.includes(heading)) {
          trail.unshift(heading);
        }
        current = current.parentElement && current.parentElement.closest('section');
      }

      const showTrail = trail.length > 1 ? trail : trail.length ? [trail[0]] : [];

      breadcrumb.innerHTML = showTrail.length
        ? showTrail
            .map((item) => `<span class="crumb">${item}</span>`)
            .join('<span class="sep">›</span>')
        : '';
    };

    const run = () => {
      updateBreadcrumb();
      if (window.Reveal && typeof Reveal.on === 'function') {
        Reveal.on('slidechanged', updateBreadcrumb);
      }
    };

    if (window.Reveal && typeof Reveal.isReady === 'function' && Reveal.isReady()) {
      run();
    } else if (window.Reveal && typeof Reveal.addEventListener === 'function') {
      Reveal.addEventListener('ready', run);
      Reveal.addEventListener('slidechanged', updateBreadcrumb);
    } else {
      setTimeout(run, 250);
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attachBreadcrumbs);
  } else {
    attachBreadcrumbs();
  }
})();
</script>
